blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Humanoid robots have the potential to automate a wide range of physical tasks. Progress toward generalist humanoid autonomy, however, remains constrained by a data bottleneck: mapping pixels and free-form language to low-level joint commands requires paired supervision, and no corpus of such data exists at sufficiently large scale. Some approaches rely on human teleoperation and wearable capture devices, which require at least an hour of human time to produce an hour of data. We present HALO, a humanoid autonomy system powered by a pipeline that synthesizes vision-language-motion data across a thousand procedurally generated homes. The corpus scales with compute rather than human labor. HALO acquires a repertoire of physical skills, including sitting on chairs, navigating to named objects, stepping sideways through half-open doors, crouching and crawling beneath tables, and pushing boxes. It orchestrates these skills to solve composite, long-horizon tasks. Without ever seeing a real home during training, HALO transfers zero-shot to the physical world, achieving a 91% success rate across 360 trials in six unmapped real-world environments. See https://apple-aiml-research.github.io/ml-halo/ for code and videos.
blocks.zh: 人造机器人具有将广泛的物理任务自动化的潜力. 然而,一般人文自主方面的进展仍然受到数据瓶颈的制约:将像素和自由形式语言映射到低级联合指令需要配对监督,而且不存在足够大规模的数据。 有些方法依赖于人类的远程操作和可穿戴的捕获装置,它们需要至少一个小时的人类时间来生成一个小时的数据. 我们介绍一个人类自主系统HALO, 由管道提供动力, 体力是计算而不是人工的 HALO获得一系列的体能技能,包括坐在椅子上,导航到被命名的物体,走过半开的门的侧面,蹲在桌子下爬行,以及推箱. 它协调这些技能,以解决复杂,长视距的任务. HALO在训练期间从未见到一个真正的家,而是将零射入物理世界,在6个未模拟现实世界环境中的360次试验取得了91%的成功率。 见 https://apple-aiml-research.github.io/ml-halo/用于代码和视频.

blocks.en:
Humanoid robots can somersault, dance, and run. Yet none of them can be invited into an unfamiliar living room and asked to sit down. They are agile but blind: a backflip is choreographed in advance and executed against geometry the robot never has to perceive. The tasks that would make a humanoid useful are not like this. They take place in rooms nobody has scanned, among furniture nobody has annotated, and the robot has to find the chair before it can sit on it. Perception enters twice, and at two levels of abstraction. It is semantic, deciding what to do: which of the objects around me does the instruction refer to? And it is physical, deciding how to move: the seat has to be met where it actually is, and the robot’s weight transferred onto it without losing balance.
Neither level is supervised the way a backflip is. A backflip requires only a reference motion clip and a tracker to follow it. Mapping pixels and free-form language to joint commands, however, demands paired supervision: an egocentric image, an instruction, and the precise whole-body trajectory that satisfies it.
blocks.zh:
人造机器人可以跳起舞来跑起 然而,没有人能被邀请到一个陌生的客厅,要求坐下。 它们是敏捷而盲目的:先用回旋绳来编程,然后用机械人永远无法察觉的几何方法执行。 能让人造物有用的任务不是这样的。 它们发生在没有人扫描过的房间里, 在没有人加注的家具中,机器人必须找到椅子才能坐上去。 感觉进入了两次,在抽象的两个层次. 这是语义性的,决定怎么办:指示指的是我身边的哪些物体? 而这是物理的,决定如何移动: 座位必须满足它的实际位置, 机器人的重量在不失去平衡的情况下转移到它上。
两个级别都没有被监督 反向滑行的方式。 一个回放只需要一个参考运动片段和一个跟踪器来跟踪它. 然而,将像素和自由形式语言映射到联合指令中,需要配对监督:一个以自我为中心的图像,一个指令,以及满足它的确切的全身轨迹.

blocks.en: In natural language processing, broad generalization has been unlocked by massive data volume [ 1 ] . But while text and video are abundant, as a byproduct of people writing and filming, whole-body motion with paired context is not. Every single episode must be deliberately produced. Teleoperation systems such as ALOHA [ 2 ] and TWIST [ 3 ] , or wearable capture devices such as UMI [ 4 ] , can generate these demonstrations, but they couple data generation with physical labor. Because a person must manually act out every episode, an hour of data costs at least an hour of human time.
blocks.zh: 在自然语言处理中,被大量的数据卷[1]解锁了广义通化. 但是,虽然文字和视频是丰富的,作为人们写作和拍摄的副产品,带有对上下文的全身运动却不是. 每集都必须刻意制作. ALOHA[2]和TWIST[3]等远程操作系统,或UMI[4]等可穿戴的捕捉装置,可以产生这些演示,但它们将数据生成与体能劳动结合起来. 因为一个人每集都必须手动出场,一个小时的数据至少花费一个小时的人的时间.

blocks.en:
In this paper, we introduce HALO (Humanoid Autonomy, Learned in simulation, running Onboard), a humanoid autonomy system powered by a data generation pipeline that produces egocentric vision-language-motion data entirely in simulation. The resulting policy runs fully onboard the physical robot. Simulation unshackles data generation from human labor. A scene can be generated, a motion synthesized, and the corresponding egocentric video rendered with no human intervention. What would have taken hours (and days, and years) of human time can instead proceed autonomously and in parallel, bounded only by compute.
To create a training episode, a motion diffusion model generates the whole-body humanoid motion, a procedural generator supplies the environment, and the simulator situates the motion in the environment to render the robot’s sensory inputs. Our training corpus comprises 300 300 hours of episodes across a thousand procedurally generated homes, none of which anyone has had to visit or scan. Data scales with compute rather than human time. Quality is maintained by automated verifiers.

在本文中,我们介绍了HALO(HALOid Association,在模拟中学习,运行Onboard),这是一个由数据生成管道提供动力的HALOid自主系统,它完全在模拟中产生以自我为中心的视觉语言运动数据. 由此产生的政策完全在物理机器人上运行。 从人类劳动力中模拟解锁数据生成. 一个场景可以生成,一个运动合成, 和相应的以自我为中心的视频 提供,没有人类的干预。 本来需要多少小时(和多少天、多少年)的人类时间,可以自动和平行地进行,只有计算才能进行。

blocks.en: The HALO autonomy stack has three layers, illustrated in Fig. 2 . An orchestrator (an off-the-shelf vision-language model invoked every two seconds) decomposes a free-form language request into a sequence of subtasks, each identifying one skill and the object it applies to. A motion generator running at 3 Hz combines a VLM-based encoder with a DiT-based decoder and maps an egocentric RGB observation and the subtask to a whole-body kinematic motion plan: five seconds of joint angles and pelvis poses. Finally, a 50 Hz motion tracker takes this motion plan in conjunction with onboard depth and proprioception, and drives the robot via joint-level actuator commands. The motion tracker is trained by large-scale reinforcement learning to follow motion plans while respecting balance, contact, and actuator limits. The first two layers settle the semantic half of the problem (which chair?); the tracker settles the physical half (meeting the seat where it actually is).
blocks.zh: HALO自发堆有三层,用图2来说明. 管弦乐器(每两秒引用一次的现成的视觉语言模型)将自由形式的语言请求分解成子任务序列,每个子任务分别识别一个技能和它应用的对象. 运行于3Hz的运动生成器会将以VLM为主的编码器与以DiT为主的解码器结合,并绘制出以自负为中心的RGB观测图和子任务到全身动能运动计划:5秒的关节角和骨盆出场. 最后,一个50Hz运动跟踪器结合机上深度和自发性来进行这个运动计划,并通过联合级起动器指令来驱动机器人. 运动跟踪器通过大规模强化学习进行训练,在遵守平衡,接触,和起动器限制的情况下,遵循运动计划. 前两层解决了问题的语义上的一半(哪个椅子?);跟踪器解决了物理上的一半(与实际位置的座位相会).

blocks.en: With this stack, HALO autonomously performs perceptive whole-body skills: sitting on chairs, navigating to named objects, stepping sideways through half-open doors, crouching and crawling beneath tables, and pushing boxes. It also orchestrates them into longer multi-step sequences in response to free-form natural-language requests ( Fig. 1 ).
blocks.zh: 有了这个堆栈,哈洛自主地进行能感知全身的技巧:坐在椅子上,向被命名的物体行走,从半开的门走入侧道,蹲下并爬入桌子下,并推出箱子. 它还根据自由形式自然语言请求(图1),将它们编为更长的多步序列.

blocks.en: This paper makes three contributions: 1. Data generation pipeline. HALO produces egocentric vision-language-motion episodes in simulation, with no teleoperation, no capture suit, and no scan of the deployment environment. Data volume is decoupled from human effort and is bounded only by compute. We train across a thousand procedurally generated home environments. 2. Onboard autonomy stack. A high-level orchestrator determines the next semantic subtask. A mid-level generator then solves this task from the current egocentric view, emitting a five-second whole-body motion plan. A low-level tracker grounds this plan in the physical world, executing the trajectory using onboard depth and proprioceptive feedback. No prior system pairs a perceptive low-level controller with a whole-body motion plan produced by a generative model running entirely onboard. 3. Whole-body autonomy demonstrated in previously unseen physical environments. Deployed on the physical robot, HALO achieves a 91% success rate over 360 trials across six real-world home environments that were neither seen during training nor scanned or mapped. The system transfers directly from simulation to novel physical environments, with no preparatory scanning of the target environment.
blocks.zh: 本文件提出了三项意见: 1. 数据生成管道。 HALO在模拟中产生以自我为中心的视觉-语言-运动事件,没有远程操作,没有捕获服,也没有扫描部署环境. 数据量与人的努力脱钩,仅以计算为界. 我们训练了一千个在程序上创造的家庭环境。 2. 机上自主堆栈。 高级管弦乐团决定下一个语义子任务. 一个中层的发电机然后从当前以自负为中心的角度解决了这个任务,排放出一个5秒的全身运动计划. 低层追踪器在物理世界中为这个计划打下基础,利用机上深度和自发反馈执行轨迹. 没有前作的系统将一个能感知到的低级控制器与全体运动计划相配对,这个全能运动计划是由一个完全运行在船上的基因模型产生的. 3. 在先前所未见的物质环境中显示全身自主。 HALO部署在物理机器人上,在对六个现实世界家庭环境进行的360次试验中取得了91%的成功率,这些家庭环境在训练期间既没有被看到,也没有被扫描或绘制地图。 系统从模拟直接转移到新的物理环境,没有进行目标环境的预备扫描.

二. 相关工作
二. 1 动议监督

blocks.en:
Whole-body behavior is typically obtained from recorded human motion, retargeted to the robot’s kinematics and tracked on hardware [ 5 , 6 , 7 ] . Reference trajectories are generally sourced from physical demonstrations, whether captured via optical rigs, teleoperation suits [ 3 ] , handheld capture devices [ 4 ] , or raw video [ 8 ] . HALO bypasses this manual data collection by generating trajectories directly, using a generative model trained on human motion [ 9 ] . A generated trajectory may not be physically realizable. It may slide a foot, penetrate the floor, or float off the ground.
Prior methods handle this physical infeasibility at different stages: it can be constrained inside the sampler [ 10 ] , caught during a physics-based rollout [ 11 ] , or repaired post-hoc within the dataset [ 12 ] . HALO applies geometric verification immediately after sampling, discarding invalid trajectories ( Section III-A ).
blocks.zh:
全身行为一般取自有记录的人类运动,重新瞄准机器人的运动并用硬件追踪[5,6,7]. 参考轨迹一般来自物理演示,无论是通过光学钻机、远程操作服[3]、手持捕获装置[4],还是原始视频[8]所捕获。 HALO绕过这种人工收集数据的方式是直接生成出轨迹,使用经过人类运动训练的基因模型[9]. 产生的轨迹可能无法实际实现。 它可能滑出一脚,穿入地上,或者从地上漂出.
先前的方法在不同阶段处理这种物理不可行性:它可能受取样器内部的限制[10],在以物理为基础的展开过程中被抓住[11],或在数据集内被修复后hoc. [12]. HALO在取样后立即进行几何核查,丢弃了无效的轨迹(第三-A节.)。
二. 2 培训环境

blocks.en: Generalizing to unseen homes requires diverse training environments, sourced via reconstruction or procedural generation. If the deployment target is known, reconstruction is highly effective: a brief video scan costs 15 × 15\times less than teleoperation [ 13 ] and often outperforms unrelated diversity [ 14 ] . Consequently, systems like VLK train and evaluate exclusively inside pre-scanned rooms [ 15 ] . True autonomy, however, demands operating in previously unseen, unmapped spaces. HALO leverages procedural generation to obtain diverse training environments [ 16 , 17 ] . Prior methods impose strict limits: GRAIL varies terrain but restricts object interactions to authored templates [ 18 ] , while FetchMan generates 150,000 150{,}000 scenes solely for a single reach-and-pick task [ 19 ] . HALO removes these restrictions, training across a thousand procedurally generated homes with different architectural layouts and furniture ( Table I ).
blocks.zh: 将住房普遍化到看不见的地方,需要不同的培训环境,通过重建或程序生成提供。 如果部署目标已知,重建就非常有效:简短的视频扫描比远程操作少了15×15\时间[13],而且往往比不相关的多样性[14]要好. 因此,像VLK这样的系统专门在被扫描前的房间内进行训练和评估[15]。 然而,真正的自主性要求在先前不为人知的、未实现的空间中运作。 HALO利用程序生成获得不同的培训环境[16,17]. 以前的方法规定了严格的限制: GRAIL 地形不同,但将对象交互限制在被作者模板 [18] ,而FeferMan 则生成15万个150{,}000个场景,仅用于单一的触地取地任务 [19]. HALO取消了这些限制,培训了一千个具有不同建筑布局和家具的按程序产生的家庭(表一)。

二. 3级全身控制

blocks.en: Systems mapping language to joint commands can be classified in terms of the interface between semantic reasoning and physical control. End-to-end approaches omit this interface entirely, predicting joint targets directly from language or vision [ 21 , 22 ] , or using generated plans solely to shape the training reward [ 23 ] . Hierarchical systems use explicit interfaces, such as a compact task-space command [ 13 , 24 ] , sparse body keypoints [ 25 ] , or a learned latent vocabulary [ 26 , 18 ] . Architectures closest to HALO pass a full whole-body kinematic trajectory [ 27 ] . Prior methods apply these with planning horizons ranging from one second [ 15 ] to an entire task [ 20 ] , and replanning rates ranging from never [ 20 ] to 2 Hz [ 11 ] . HALO adopts a receding-horizon strategy. It plans five seconds ahead but replans at 3 Hz, executing only the leading part of a trajectory before a fresh observation supersedes it. Furthermore, HALO expands this hierarchy with a high-level orchestrator that translates a free-form natural language request into a sequence of subtasks, advancing upon success and actively retrying upon failure.
blocks.zh: 系统映射语言到联合指令可以按照语义推理和物理控制之间的接口进行分类. 端到端方法完全省略了这个接口,直接从语言或愿景中预测联合目标[21,22],或者仅仅使用生成的计划来塑造培训奖励[23]. 分级系统使用明确的界面,如紧凑的任务-空间指令[13,24],稀疏的正体键 [25],或已学到的潜在词汇 [26,18]. 距离HALO最近的建筑通过全身运动轨迹[27]. 采用以前的方法,规划范围从1秒[15]到整个任务[20]不等,重新规划率从永远[20]到2赫兹[11]不等。 HALO采取了退赛战略。 它计划提前5秒,但在3赫兹重新规划,在一次新的观察取代它之前,只执行轨道的主要部分. 此外,哈洛还利用高级管弦乐器扩大这一等级,将自由形式的自然语言请求翻译为一行子任务,在成功后推进,并在失败后积极重试.
二. 4 感知低水平控制

blocks.en: A purely proprioceptive controller is blind to the physical geometry of the environment. Incorporating vision at the low level is a mature line of work [ 28 , 29 , 30 , 31 , 32 , 33 ] , but these perceptive policies are typically trained for narrow, specialized skills like traversing clutter [ 34 ] . While some frameworks attempt to generalize by selecting [ 35 ] or chaining [ 36 ] these skills online, they remain constrained by a finite repertoire. Conversely, general-purpose trackers capable of following an arbitrary reference motion lack perception. Current systems that generate dynamic whole-body references pass them to these blind trackers [ 7 , 8 , 20 , 15 , 11 ] , leaving the robot unable to react if the physical environment deviates from the generated plan. HALO bridges this gap by introducing a perceptive tracker that integrates egocentric depth to follow generated whole-body reference trajectories.
blocks.zh: 纯自控控制器对物理几何环境视而不见. 在低水平上融入视觉是一条成熟的工作线[28、29、30、31、32、33],但这些感知性政策通常是为了像穿梭穿梭[34]这样的狭窄的专门技能而训练的。 虽然有些框架试图通过在线选择[35]或连锁[36]这些技能来概括,但它们仍然受到有限循环的限制。 相反,能够跟踪任意引用运动的通用跟踪器缺乏感知. 目前产生动态全身参考的系统将它们传递给这些盲目跟踪器[7,8,20,15,11],使得机器人在物理环境偏离所生成的计划时无法作出反应. HALO通过引入能感知的跟踪器来弥补这一差距,这种跟踪器将自我中心深度融合在一起,以跟随生成的全身参考轨迹.
二. 5 实实在在的评价

blocks.en: The true capability of a simulation-trained policy is defined by its evaluation in the physical world: how many distinct real environments it encounters, and whether those environments were seen during training. Prior work reports limited trials in physical environments that were not seen during training ( Table I ). VLK is evaluated exclusively inside two rooms that were previously scanned and used for training the system [ 15 ] . TANGO is tested in three rooms [ 11 ] , while ZeroWBC and GRAIL report total trial counts without specifying the number of unique environments [ 20 , 18 ] . HALO establishes a more rigorous protocol. We evaluate six distinct whole-body skills across six real-world environments over 360 physical trials. Crucially, none of these spaces were scanned, reconstructed, or seen during training, ensuring strict zero-shot transfer to hardware.
blocks.zh: 模拟训练政策的真正能力由它在物理世界的评价加以界定:它遇到多少不同的实际环境,以及这些环境是否在训练期间被看到。 以往的工作报告限制了在实际环境中进行的训练(表一)。 对VLK的评价完全在两个房间内进行,这两个房间以前曾扫描过,用于培训该系统[15]。 TANGO在3个房间进行测试[11],而ZeroWBC和GRAL则报告全部审判数,但没有具体说明独特环境的数量[20,18]. HALO建立了一个更严格的协议. 在360次物理试验中,我们评价了6个现实世界环境中的6个独特的整体技能。 关键是,这些空间都没有在训练期间被扫描、重建或看到,确保严格零发转至硬件。
页:1 方法

blocks.en:
HALO maps natural language and egocentric vision to low-level joint commands in previously unseen real-world environments. Deployed entirely onboard, it requires no prior scene reconstruction, external motion capture, or privileged object state. We train on diverse procedurally generated synthetic data, described in Section III-A . The onboard autonomy stack has three layers, shown in Fig. 2 .
At the highest layer, a vision-language model (VLM) orchestrates long-horizon behavior by parsing free-form requests into a sequence of linguistic subtasks ( Section III-D ). Bridging semantics and control, a mid-level motion generator maps the active subtask and egocentric RGB into a whole-body kinematic motion plan ( Section III-B ). This plan is a 5-second, 30 30\, Hz trajectory specifying 29 29 joint angles and a relative pelvis pose per frame ( 36 36 values total). Finally, a learned motion tracker executes this reference trajectory on hardware using onboard depth and proprioception ( Section III-C ).
blocks.zh:
HALO将自然语言和以自我为中心的视觉映射到之前所未见的现实世界环境中的低等联合指令. 完全部署在机上,它不需要前场重建,外部运动捕捉,或特权对象状态. 我们在第三-A节中描述了各种程序生成的合成数据。 机上自主堆栈有三层,以图2显示.
在最高层,一个视觉-语言模型(VLM)通过将自由形式请求分解为一系列语言子任务(第三节-D.)来管弦长视距行为. 一个中层运动发生器将活动子任务和以自负为中心的RGB映射成全身运动计划(第三节-B节)。 这个计划是5秒30分,Hz轨迹,指定了29个相接角和每个相框的相对骨盆外形(共36个值). 最后,一个有学识的运动跟踪器使用机上深度和自取力在硬件上执行这个参考轨迹(第三节-C.).

blocks.en: Fig. 3 : Synthetic data generation and training pipeline. (A) Each task is decomposed into segments defined by text prompts and keyframe poses. After sampling target asset locations and routing navigation waypoints, a conditional diffusion model synthesizes motion segments from these constraints, stitching them into a continuous whole-body trajectory. (B) This generated trajectory and its associated assets are embedded into procedurally generated scenes, ensuring collision-free placement. (C) A simulator replays the kinematic motion to render egocentric vision from the robot’s head-mounted cameras. Visual domain randomization is applied to maximize appearance diversity. (D) The resulting corpus is used for training the autonomy stack, via imitation learning for the motion generator and via reinforcement learning for the motion tracker.

三-A 合成数据生成

blocks.en: The synthetic data generation pipeline is shown in Fig. 3 and detailed in Section -A .
blocks.zh: 合成数据生成管道如图3所示,详细情况见-A节。
III-A 1 运动生成

blocks.en: We decompose each task into a sequence of motion segments. Each segment is parameterized by a text prompt, optional waypoint guidance, and a terminal keyframe pose defining the object interaction. For example, the task ‘sit on the armchair’ breaks down into ‘walk forward’, ‘turn around’, and ‘sit on chair’. Waypoints for the ‘walk forward’ segment guide the robot to the front of the seat, while the final segment enforces a seated keyframe anchored to the target asset. This decomposition is written once per task and reused across every procedurally generated environment. See Section -A for details of the complete segment chain, constraint types, and continuity transformations applied at segment seams. To curate a complete trajectory, we first sample valid locations for the robot and target assets, computing the navigation path via a non-holonomic unicycle planner. We then pass the textual and geometric constraints (waypoints and keyframes) to Kimodo [ 9 ] , a kinematic motion diffusion model. Kimodo generates dense whole-body motion for each individual segment, which we then stitch into a single, continuous global trajectory. However, because Kimodo operates purely kinematically, its trajectories may not be physically realizable. Left unchecked, the output can exhibit severe artifacts such as foot sliding, floor penetration, or discontinuous jumps. To improve physical plausibility, we generate N N candidate trajectories per segment, score them with forward-kinematics geometric verifiers (checking foot skating, floor penetration, flight phases, and joint limits), and retain the highest-scoring candidate.
blocks.zh: 我们把每个任务分解成一系列运动段. 每个段都通过文本提示,可选的方式点引导来参数化,一个终端键框可以定义对象交互. 例如, " 坐在椅子上 " 的任务分为 " 走在前面 " 、 " 转身 " 和 " 坐在椅子上 " 。 " 前进行走 " 部分的路标引导机器人到座位前方,而最后部分则执行固定在目标资产上的坐椅键框。 这种分解方式是每次任务一次写出,并在每个程序生成的环境重复使用. 完整的分链、制约类型和分接所应用的连续性转变的详细情况,见第-A节。 为了掌握完整的轨迹,我们首先对机器人和目标资产的有效位置进行取样,通过非全能单循环规划器计算导航路径. 然后我们把文字和几何限制(指向和键框)传给了Kimodo[9],这是一种运动扩散模型。 Kimodo为每个单个部分产生密集的全身运动, 然后我们把它缝合成一个单一的连续的全球轨道。 然而,由于克莫多的操作纯粹是运动性的,其轨迹可能无法在物理上实现. 如果不加控制,输出可以显示严重的文物,如脚滑行、地板穿透或不连续地跳出等。 为了提高物理可信度,我们每段生成N N 候选轨迹,用前向光谱几何校验仪(检查脚步滑冰,地上穿透,飞行阶段和联想极限)来评分,并保留得分最高的候选人.
三-A 2 设想

blocks.en:
To construct the training corpus, we leverage Infinigen [ 17 ] to procedurally generate 1,000 1{,}000 distinct rooms of three types (living rooms, offices, and bedrooms) with diverse sizes and furniture.
Unlike reconstruction-based pipelines [ 15 ] , this approach requires no physical 3D scans and no manual asset annotation. Environmental diversity scales with compute rather than human labor.
To situate a task within a scene, we first extract a 2D occupancy grid from the generated layout. We then jointly embed the synthesized trajectory and its target asset into the scene by sampling SE ⁡ ( 2 ) \mathrm{SE}(2) transform candidates, accepting the first configuration that avoids collisions between the kinematic trajectory, the asset, and the surrounding furniture. Because every episode is deterministically defined by a random seed and a lightweight placement record, motion generation and rendering are decoupled: the corpus can be re-rendered at new resolutions, with different camera intrinsics, or inside entirely different physics simulators without regenerating the underlying motion.

与基于重建的管道[15]不同,这种方法不需要物理3D扫描,也不需要人工资产注释. 环境多样性以计算而不是以人类劳动力来衡量。
为了将任务放在一个场景中,我们首先从生成的布局中提取出一个2D占用网格. 然后我们通过采样 SE (2)\mathrm{SE}(2) 转换候选者, 共同将合成的轨迹及其目标资产嵌入现场, 因为每集都由随机种子和轻量级放置记录来定型,运动生成和渲染被解相:在新的分辨率下可以重新发相,相机内含不同的相机,或者在完全不同的物理模拟器内部,而无需再生成基础运动.
III-A 3 偏心渲染

blocks.en: We kinematically replay staged trajectories in scenes generated by Infinigen , rendering egocentric vision through a hardware-matched simulated fisheye lens. To narrow the visual sim-to-real gap, we apply extensive domain randomization encompassing varied color temperature, exposure, contrast, motion blur, and sensor noise ( Fig. 3 C). Because native path-traced rendering is computationally prohibitive at this scale, we bake global illumination and shading into per-object emissive textures. This one-time preprocessing enables interactive rendering via any standard rasterizer, making the pipeline highly scalable and simulator-agnostic. The resulting corpus comprises 300 300 hours of paired video, language, and motion across 1,000 1{,}000 environments. (For later controlled experiments in simulation, episodes are drawn exclusively from completely held-out environments, rather than novel trajectories within training environments.)
blocks.zh: 在Infinigen生成的场景中,我们动动地重放舞台轨迹,通过一个硬件相配的模拟鱼眼镜头来渲染自我中心视觉。 为了缩小视觉成真差距,我们采用广泛的域随机化,包括不同的颜色温度、曝光、对比、运动模糊和传感器噪音(图3 C)。 由于本地路径跟踪的渲染在这个尺度上在计算上是令人望而却步的,我们烤出全球发光并遮蔽成每个物体的发光纹理. 这种一次性的预处理能够通过任何标准的光栅进行交互渲染,使管道高度可扩展并具有模拟-可知性. 其制作程序包括300个300小时的对接视频、语言和在1,000 1{} 000个环境中的运动。 (对于后来在模拟中被控制的实验,事件完全取自被完全搁置的环境,而不是训练环境中的新轨迹. )

示范建筑

blocks.en: The motion generator is an asymmetric encoder-decoder. The encoder is a Qwen3.5-2B VLM that maps an egocentric RGB image and a natural-language command into a joint feature embedding. Pretrained VLMs already possess rich, web-scale alignment between visual observations and semantic concepts such as ‘sit on the chair’ or ‘push the box’. Keeping the encoder frozen leverages these robust representations while requiring only a single forward pass and no optimizer state for its two billion parameters. The decoder is a diffusion transformer [ 37 ] that is trained from scratch ( 8 8 blocks, width 512 512 , 8 8 heads) . It takes as input the VLM feature embedding and generates the dense whole-body motion plan. The decoder is trained via flow matching [ 38 ] and sampled using 15 15 Euler steps during inference.
blocks.zh: 运动发生器是一种不对称的编码器-解码器. 编码器为Qwen3.5-2B VLM,将以自我为中心的RGB图像和自然语言指令映射为联合特性嵌入. 预先训练的VLM已经具备了丰富的网络尺度的视觉观察和语义概念,如 " 坐到椅子上 " 或 " 推出盒子 " 。 保持编码器被冷冻,可以带动这些强势的表示,同时只需一个前传,其20亿个参数没有优化状态. 解码器是一种从零开始训练的散射变压器[37] (8个8个出道口,宽度为512 512,8个出道口). 它将VLM特征嵌入并生成密集的全身运动计划作为输入. 解码器通过流量匹配[38]进行训练,并在推论时使用15个15个欧拉步骤进行取样.
III-B 2 同步生成

blocks.en:
Closed-loop deployment requires the motion generator to run continuously as new observations arrive. A naive synchronous schedule executes the current plan to completion before invoking the generator on a fresh observation. Because neural inference is not instantaneous, the robot is left without a control signal during the forward pass and must hold its last commanded pose. This stall is inherently unsmooth, fracturing behavior into disjointed segments. It is also physically unsafe: a dynamic system cannot simply pause mid-stride or mid-jump. We therefore run the generator asynchronously. The system computes the next motion plan while the tracker executes the current one. While this eliminates the stall, it introduces a consistency requirement. The current plan spans [ T , T + H ) [T,T+H) ; the subsequent plan becomes ready at T + d T+d , where 0 < d < H 0<d<H . To prevent kinematic jitter at the swap, this newly generated trajectory must smoothly extend the exact state the robot will reach at T + d T+d . Methods like real-time chunking (RTC) [ 39 ] attempt to close this seam at inference time by using overlapping frames as an inpainting target. This approach suffers from two critical drawbacks. First, continuity is
not mathematically guaranteed. Second, computing this gradient incurs a heavy latency penalty at every denoising step. Instead, we adopt a training-time conditioning formulation [ 40 ] . The P = 15 P{=}15 frames ( 0.5 0.5\, s) the robot is already committed to executing are passed directly into the generator as clean, noise-free tokens. These occupy the first P P frames of the sequence, and the model only denoises the remaining H − P = 135 H-P=135 frames ( 4.5 4.5\, s). Trained to strictly complete a given prefix, the model internalizes continuity natively. Smooth kinematic transitions become an inherent property of the network rather than a costly inference-time patch, allowing fresh motion plans to stream continuously to the low-level tracker.

三-C 运动跟踪培训

blocks.en:
We ground kinematic plans into physical execution
in three phases: (1) training privileged single-skill experts, (2) distilling them into a unified depth-based student, and (3) fine-tuning via reinforcement learning with actuator modeling and domain randomization for robust sim-to-real transfer ( Section -C ).
blocks.zh:
我们的地面动能计划进入实际执行
分三个阶段:(1) 培训有特权的单技能专家,(2) 将其分解成统一的深层学生,(3) 通过强化学习进行微调,使用起动器模型和域随机化,以进行稳健的sim-to-real转移(C节)。
三-C 1阶段 1: 特权专家

blocks.en: We begin by training a dedicated PPO expert for each distinct skill. The experts are trained on our synthesized trajectories ( Section III-A ) and LAFAN1 human motion clips [ 41 ] retargeted to the Unitree G1 [ 42 ] . These experts leverage privileged simulation data, observing proprioception, the next 10 planned frames, and ground-truth scene geometry via local height maps. Each expert outputs joint position targets at 50 50\, Hz, which are executed by a low-level PD controller. All experts share an imitation reward that penalizes tracking error on key kinematic links. However, pose imitation alone fails for manipulation. Executing a perfect posture while leaving the target object stationary is a critical failure that purely kinematic rewards cannot detect. Object-centric experts therefore add supplementary terms that reward hand proximity and correct object displacement.
blocks.zh: 我们首先培训一名专职的PPO专家,以掌握每一种独特的技能。 专家们接受了关于我们综合轨迹(第三-A节)和LAFAN1人类运动片段[41]重新瞄准Unitree G1[42]的培训。 这些专家利用特权的模拟数据、自行观察、下10个计划框架和通过当地高地图的地真相场景几何。 每位专家将联合职位目标定为50分 Hz,由低级别PD控制器执行. 所有专家都分享模仿奖励,惩罚跟踪关键动能链接出错的行为. 然而,仅凭模仿是无法操纵的。 在使目标物体处于静止状态的同时执行完美的姿态,是纯粹动能奖励无法发现的关键性失败. 因此,以物体为中心的专家增加了补充条款,奖励手相近和纠正物体转移。
第二阶段:多教师蒸馏

blocks.en: We distill the experts into a single student conditioned only on onboard inputs: the motion plan, egocentric depth, proprioception, and the IMU. During distillation, each simulation instance is supervised by the corresponding expert, so the student never averages conflicting actions from different experts. Training follows a hybrid behavior cloning and Dataset Aggregation (DAgger) strategy [ 43 ] , in which trajectories are collected through a mixture of teacher-driven and student-driven rollouts. A 1D convolution encodes the proprioceptive history, a convolutional network processes the depth image, and a residual MLP maps the resulting latents to target joint positions. The student does not receive object or terrain coordinates and must infer that geometry from depth.
blocks.zh: 我们把专家们提炼成一个只有机上输入条件的学生:运动计划、以自我为中心的深度、自主和IMU。 在蒸馏过程中,每个模拟实例都由相应的专家监督,因此学生从不估计不同专家的相冲突行为. 培训遵循混合行为克隆和数据集聚合(Dagger)策略[43],其中通过由教师驱动和学生驱动的混合推出来收集轨迹. 1D分解编码了自发历史,一个分解网络处理深度图像,一个残余的MLP映射由此而来的潜在物来瞄准联合位置. 学生不接收物体或地形坐标,必须从深度推断出该几何.
三-C 3 阶段3:多批评微调

blocks.en: Distillation is bounded by teacher competence, and partial observability introduces a residual tracking gap. We therefore apply reinforcement learning directly on the student with depth in the loop. To resolve reward-scale disparity across skills, we use multi-critic PPO: the actor is shared, but each skill maintains an independent critic initialized from its Phase 1 expert. Each critic trains exclusively on samples from its skill and normalizes its advantages independently, preventing high-magnitude returns from dominating the policy gradient.
blocks.zh: 分解以教师的能力为限制,部分可观察性带来了剩余跟踪差距。 因此,我们直接在学生身上应用强化学习,在循环中具有深度。 为了解决不同技能之间奖励规模的差距,我们使用多批评的PPO:演员是共享的,但每种技能都保留着从第一阶段专家中初始化的独立评论家. 每个评论家都专门根据自己的技能进行抽样培训,独立地使其优势正常化,防止高强度回报占据政策梯度。
三-C 4 实向转移

blocks.en:
Beyond domain randomization, we explicitly model actuator physics to minimize the sim-to-real gap. Following OmniXtreme [ 44 ] , we analytically derive joint PD gains from motor rotor inertia to guarantee uniform natural frequencies and damping ratios across all joints, and scale actions by joint torque limits. A random action delay simulates hardware command latency. To protect motor drivers during deep crouches, the reward function directly penalizes excessive negative mechanical power at the knees. This keeps the policy from relying on torques that the simulator silently clips but the real motors cannot deliver.
Remaining sim-to-real gaps are handled by domain randomization, which is kept narrow in Phases 1 and 2 to preserve teacher fidelity, then widened in Phase 3. We randomize physical parameters including surface friction, restitution, base center-of-mass, actuator gains, joint offsets, external impulse pushes, and object mass. Concurrently, the egocentric depth stream is corrupted with simulated dropout, speckle noise, frame latency, and camera mount misalignments. Unlike blind trackers that trip over unmodeled terrain, our depth-conditioned policy leverages this robust training to actively negotiate geometric variation that the upstream kinematic plan failed to anticipate ( Table III ).
blocks.zh:
除了域随机化外,我们明确模拟了动因子物理学,以最小化成实相间隙. 在OmniXtreme [44] 之后,我们从运动转子惯性中分析得出联合PD增益,以保证所有关节上统一的自然频率和起坝比,以及用联合扭矩限制的尺度行动. 随机动作延迟模拟了硬件命令的延迟. 为了在深蹲时保护机动车驾驶员,奖励功能直接惩罚膝盖上过度的负力机械. 这使得政策无法依赖模拟器静默地剪接但真实的马达无法交付的扭矩.
剩余的sim-to-real差距通过域随机化处理,在第一和第二阶段保持狭义以保持教师忠诚,再在第三阶段被拓宽. 我们将物理参数随机化,包括表面摩擦,还原,基础中心质量,起动器增益,联合抵消,外冲推,以及物体质量. 同时,以自负为中心的深度流被模拟的退赛,相机噪声,相机悬空,相机挂错相机所腐蚀. 与在未建模地上出行的盲目跟踪者不同,我们深层条件的政策利用这种强健的训练,积极谈判上游运动计划未能预料到的几何变化(表三)。
三-D 为长期任务提供管弦乐

blocks.en: While the generator and tracker excel at atomic, short-horizon behaviors, true autonomy requires satisfying open-ended, long-horizon requests. To achieve this, we top the stack with a VLM-based task orchestrator ( Fig. 2 ). Unconstrained natural language presents two fundamental challenges. First, it is inherently underspecified. A command like ‘sit down’ names no explicit target, forcing the system to infer the intended object directly from the visual context. Second, implicit geometric preconditions often expand a single request into a complex sequence. For instance, ‘sit on the chair’ translates to a single subtask if the path is clear, but requires a chained sequence of crouching, approaching, and sitting if a table obstructs the robot. To navigate this, the orchestrator processes the egocentric video stream to resolve ambiguous instructions into an ordered plan of actionable subtasks. It drives this sequence in a closed loop. By continuously monitoring the environment, the VLM evaluates the success of the current action, advances the plan when appropriate, and dynamically retries if a failure occurs. At each step, it passes a single, explicit subtask down to the motion generator for execution ( Section -D ). By default, the orchestrator runs onboard on the Mac mini using Qwen3.6-35B-A3B (4-bit, MLX), sharing a serving engine with the motion generator ( Section -D ), to enable operation without internet connectivity. Optionally, it can route requests to frontier cloud models via their APIs for stronger reasoning and planning capabilities.
blocks.zh: 虽然发电机和追踪器在原子,短视行为上表现优异,但真正的自主性需要满足无限,长视距的要求. 为了实现这一目标,我们用一个基于VLM的任务管弦乐器(图2)来顶上堆放. 不受限制的自然语言提出了两个根本性的挑战. 首先,它本身就不够具体。 类似“ 坐下”这样的命令没有明确的目标,迫使系统直接从视觉上下文推断预定对象。 其次,隐含的几何先决条件往往会将单个请求扩展为复杂的序列. 例如,如果路径清晰,`坐在椅子上 ' 就会变成一个单一的子任务,但如果桌子阻碍机器人,则需要一连串地蹲下、靠近和坐着。 为了导航,管弦乐团将以自负为中心的视频流处理,以解决含糊不清的指令,将其编入一个有序的可操作子任务计划. 它以闭环方式驱动此序列. 通过持续地监测环境,VLM评估当前行动的成功,酌情推进计划,并在出现失败时动态地重复. 每一步,它都会将一个单一的,明确的子任务传递给运动发生器执行(第-D节). 默认情况下,管弦乐器会使用Qune3.6-35B-A3B(4-bit,MLX)在Mac迷你机上运行,与运动发生器(section-D)共享一个服务引擎,以便在没有互联网连接的情况下实现运行. 可选的是,它可以通过它们的API将请求引向前沿云模型,以达到更强的推理和规划能力.
四. 试验
数据和培训

blocks.en: The primary training corpus comprises 300 300 hours of episodes over 1,000 1{,}000 procedurally generated homes ( Section III-A ). Synthesizing this data requires 48 48 hours across 250 250 H100 GPUs, operating without human intervention. The generator trains on 64 64 B200 GPUs, while the tracker uses 4 4 H100 GPUs. Held-out episodes (for controlled experiments in simulation) are always staged in completely held-out environments, rather than merely novel trajectories within familiar spaces. Consequently, every performance metric represents generalization to an unseen space.

四-B系统

blocks.en:
Our hardware platform is a Unitree G1 with two physical modifications: a custom head mount carrying an OAK-1W camera, and a rear enclosure housing a Mac mini M4 Pro (64 GB). Perception and control are distributed across these two machines in a fully untethered, asynchronous cascade linked via ZeroMQ ( Section -E ). In the outer loop, the OAK-1W streams a 120 ∘ 120^{\circ} RGB view ( 1280 × 800 1280{\times}800 , 30 fps) to the Mac mini, where the orchestrator and motion generator compute the kinematic reference trajectory. This trajectory serves as the setpoint for the inner control loop running on the robot’s factory Jetson Orin NX. The tracker consumes the plan alongside a 55 ∘ 55^{\circ} downward-facing Intel RealSense D435i stream ( 424 × 240 424{\times}240 , 30 fps) to issue low-level joint commands. To guarantee strict cycle timing, the tracker is engineered as a C++ real-time process on a PREEMPT_RT kernel. It communicates with the hardware interface via lock-free triple buffers, ensuring the control loop never blocks.
We bypass the D435i’s native noisy depth processing, and route the raw stereo IR pair directly into a TensorRT-accelerated stereo matching model [ 45 ] on the Jetson Orin NX. The model estimates clean depth at 30 Hz without the disocclusion or speckle artifacts typical of the native output.

and Push (push a box).
Each task is evaluated in 100 100 simulated and 6 6 real-world environments, with 10 10 trials per task per environment – 6,000 6{,}000 simulated and 360 360 real-world trials in total. Table II reports the mean success rate for each task.
The policy achieves high single-task transfer (91% sim, 91% real).

IV-D 多任务评价

blocks.en:
To evaluate long-horizon competence, we run the full system with the orchestrator across three representative multi-task sequences in both simulation and the real world.
The results are summarized in Table II .
Overall, the VLM’s task decomposition is robust for the two- and three-subtask chains we evaluate. Chained success falls below the product of the single-task rates ( 71 % 71\% against 89 % 89\% for Door→Go-To ), so the subtasks are not independent.

blocks.en:
Finer-grained analysis indicates that the pose in which one subtask ends is an additional factor in multi-task success. Although domain randomization during data generation covers different initial poses, the base position and heading can sometimes be out of distribution. For example, in the real-world Crouch→Go-To→Push test, 3 of 5 failed trials (60%) end the crouch with the head turned away from the box; the robot never brings it into view and is distracted by other objects. Similarly, two trials of Crouch→Sit end up trying to sit on the sofa on the right instead of the chair because of the ultimate pose of the crouching segment. The same effect appears in simulation for Door→Go-To : walking through the door succeeds 85% of the time within the chain, but because the door pose varies across scenes, the exit heading varies with it, and the target object can leave the field of view entirely, yielding an 83% conditional success rate for Go-To and a 71% success rate overall.
These cases share a single cause (the next subtask begins with its target unobserved), which suggests adding basic recovery behaviors such as search and turn-in-place to make chaining robust.
blocks.zh:
Fineer-grained分析表明,一个子任务结束的姿势是多任务成功的另一个因素. 虽然在数据生成过程中域随机化覆盖了不同的初始外观,但基位和标题有时可能会出自分布. 例如,在现实世界Crouch-Go-To-Push测试中,5个失败的试题中有3个(60%)结束用头从盒子中转出;机器人从未将其带入视野,被其他物体分心. 同样,对Crouch的两起审判 由于蹲地部分的最终姿势,坐到右侧的沙发上,而不是椅子上. 在模拟Door_Go-To 中也出现了同样的效果:走入门成功的时间在链条内占85%,但由于门的姿势因场景而异,出道方向随之而异,而目标对象可以完全离开视野,因此Go-To的有条件成功率达到83%,整体成功率达到71%.
这些案件有一个共同的原因(下一个子任务开始于其目标未被观察到),这表明增加了搜索和转场等基本恢复行为,使链条坚固.

blocks.en:
Table III isolates the contribution of each stage while holding the rest of the system fixed.
First, we vary the number of environments in which the motion is staged from 1 1 to 1,000 1{,}000 , holding all other stages fixed and training policies jointly on all six tasks. This isolates the effect of environment diversity from motion quantity. Scaling the number of environments from 1 to 100 sharply boosts the success rate ( 43 % 43\% to 81 % 81\% ), while scaling further yields 3 additional percentage points.
Next, without real-time chunking (RTC), the motion plan jumps at every swap and the success rate falls to 24 % 24\% . Inference-time RTC smooths the transition through a guidance gradient, but only encourages continuity rather than guaranteeing it; it introduces additional inference latency and still
trails training-time conditioning by 18 18 percentage points ( 66 % 66\% against 84 % 84\% ).
Replacing the flow-matching DiT with a regression decoder using the same transformer backbone lowers the success rate to 19 % 19\% . RTC does not directly
apply to a non-diffusion model, so we lose continuity in the asynchronous
generation setting. The regression decoder also overfits easily: outside the training
distribution, the plan retains only the coarse root path, losing joint detail,
resulting in foot skating.
Finally, removing depth leaves only proprioception, lowering the success rate to 74 % 74\% .

五 结论

blocks.en:
We show that simulation can serve as the data engine for humanoid
autonomy. Simulation removes the human operator from the data loop, unshackling data generation from human labor.
The resulting stack transfers zero-shot to real environments that were neither seen during training nor scanned or mapped.

自治。 模拟将人类操作员从数据循环中去除,从人类劳动力中解析出数据生成.
由此产生的堆放将零射入在训练期间既没有看到也没有扫描或绘图的实际环境。
五. 1 限制和今后的工作

blocks.en:
First, our pipeline removes the operator from data collection, but not from task
design: adding a new physical task still requires a human to write its prompt
and author the keyframes of its motion sequence, so the repertoire grows only as
fast as a person can specify additional tasks.
Second, the robot’s sensory input is largely based on vision, which does not provide direct perception of contact: once an object leaves the camera’s field of view or is occluded, the policy has no signal that it is still there, and contact-rich tasks degrade accordingly. Tactile sensing would be a natural solution. Third, the
interface between the motion generator and the motion tracker is narrow; the tracker follows the kinematic plan without knowing what the plan is for. Communicating the intended future state of the
world would be a natural next step. Finally, our
orchestration layer is relatively simple;
as the repertoire of tasks grows, we expect to need a more agentic system.
